snippet.title: Catnip Cosmos - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Demo launch trailer for Catnip Cosmos, a side-view shooter built around deep incremental progression. Shoot. Upgrade. Incrementally progress further. Pilot cat-operated spaceships on timed Zoomies runs, combine pilots for powerful synergies, defeat boss challenges to unlock new weapons, and improve exponentially. Catnip Cosmos is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
